legacyContent.audienceContext: Jewish Christians being encouraged to remain with the apostles' teaching rather than return to Judaism.
majorMovements: God's voice in these last days
God has spoken to us by His Son
Christ as the image/revelation of God
legacyContent.summary: A Hebrews 1:1–3 sermon contrasting God's revelation through the fathers and prophets in times past with His climactic revelation through His Son in the last days, emphasizing Christ as the image and revelation of God.
closingResponse: Believe that Jesus is the Messiah

brl.idNote: SER-HEB-002 is retained as an existing legacy series-planning label; it is not treated here as a newly assigned permanent BRL sermon ID.

provenance.notes: Metadata records the legacy source without rewriting or modernizing the sermon.
